description:
Join Notability and shape the future of learning.  We’re building the next generation of tools designed not just to capture notes, but to fundamentally improve how people learn, think, and collaborate. Our app brings the natural expressiveness of paper into the digital age, empowering millions of students, educators, and professionals worldwide to organize their ideas, deepen their understanding, and achieve their goals. Our mission is simple:  we help you learn. 

 
As part of our team, you’ll help create experiences driven by empathy, exceptional design, and the belief that great ideas can come from anywhere—including you. Come help us make learning better for everyone.

 We're seeking an early-career software engineer to join Notability’s backend team.  We own the central systems used by all the Notability clients and deal with API requests, scalability challenges, build tooling, and more. You'll be part of a team building value for our business through rapid iteration, sound judgment, and clear, generous communication. We are the pillar holding up Notability’s future business growth.

 Your responsibilities 

 
 Own core features across our entire backend system, from direct interactions with client software to database queries to the nitty-gritty of scalability challenges.

 Ship stable, readable, well-tested code serving Notability’s whole business

 Communicate clearly, concisely and proactively in writing, conversation and use of AI: crisp problem statements and messages, readable PR descriptions, well-timed questions, honest status

 Drive your work to completion: you find a way around ambiguity, review feedback, and edge cases

 Jump into unfamiliar areas to solve tough problems

 Operate with respect for the ideas, victories, mistakes, and time of your collaborators

 Take in feedback from mentors and peers to continuously self-improve

 Bring ideas and opinions: balance product and tech needs through open collaboration

 
 Requirements 

 
 Evidence you've shipped something real, professionally or on your own

 Clear, concise communication, written and verbal: you make complex things simple for the people around you, and teammates are energized by working with you

 Good judgment, and ownership of outcomes rather than tasks

 Genuine care for the people you work with: you build trust, give and receive feedback well, and treat collaboration as the job rather than an interruption to it

 Solid grasp of web fundamentals (browser, network, async behavior, application state)

 Fluency with AI coding tools

 Demonstrated curiosity: something you built, wrote, or figured out on your own initiative

 
 Nice To Have 

 
 Comfort reading and reasoning about TypeScript, and modern web code

 Experience with GraphQL

 Experience with infrastructure as code and/or Docker

 Experience with Google Cloud Provider or Amazon Web Services

 Experience building with LLM APIs, agents, or AI-assisted developer workflows

 Writing, teaching or learning in public via a blog, repo, etc

 
 For this position we are targeting a base pay between $120,000-$175,000.  Actual compensation offered will be determined by factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
 This role follows a hybrid model, with a minimum of two days onsite at our downtown San Francisco office and flexibility to work remotely from home the rest of the week.

 How We Work 

 Each member of our team contributes to all parts of our products.  We trust each other to make decisions independently while also considering our common goals and values.  We share ideas openly, and we collaborate across disciplines to ensure that our decisions make sense from all perspectives.

 When We Work 

 We actively promote work-life balance.  Our schedules are flexible, our hybrid policy supports remote work when it makes sense, and we have a “as long as you get your work done” approach to time off.

 Why You'd Love Working Here 

 We work in downtown SF near Market Street, just a short walk from two BART/Muni stations.  Our office has height-adjustable desks to help us stay limber, spacious conference rooms for both small and large team meetings, and a well-stocked kitchen full of goodies to enjoy :). Our team is growing, collaborative and down to earth.  We want everyone to do their best work and find passion in what they do.

 Benefits 

 
 Competitive compensation that includes base salary, bonuses and profit sharing

 Equity Awards in the form of Stock Options

 Comprehensive healthcare fully covered for you and your family including medical, dental, and vision

 Flexible work and vacation schedules

 401k with matching contributions

 Matching gifts to nonprofits

 Lunch Stipend (When Working from HQ)

 Public transit stipend

 Home workstation reimbursement

 ISP stipend

 Monthly phone bill stipend

 
 Notability is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusivity in the workplace. All aspects of employment are decided on the basis of merit, qualifications, and business needs. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
